research_scope: Engineering screening of a bounded threshold update for resource-per-request controls. Not an IPCA modification or a novelty claim.

threshold_policy.initial: C0: the ordinary threshold at the end of the common 896-row warmup
threshold_policy.updated: Original 99th percentile with method=higher of the common latest 512 eligible scores
threshold_policy.downward_step: Immediate to the ordinary candidate when it is lower
threshold_policy.histories: One common unfiltered score history per underlying method, independent of arm flags
threshold_policy.valid_initial_threshold: Finite and strictly positive, otherwise this record is technically unevaluable for this comparison; retain it, no replacement or epsilon tuning
threshold_policy.nonfinite_candidate: Technical failure; keep artifacts, no substitutions

ipca_scope.reason: The known short event has point alarms on all nine rows, but no 10s recovery. Lowering its auxiliary threshold cannot create that missing quiet interval when scores/base flags remain identical.
ipca_scope.interpretation: Any positive result on resource controls cannot be advertised as improved IPCA.

collection.normal_between_events: Normal resumes at each actual event end; event starts are fixed, not shifted by first duration
collection.normal_record: Same load timeline, no extra work in either event slot
collection.extra_work: Existing owned application operation: 20ms thread CPU target, 100ms wall cap; actual execution logged. Keep settings unchanged.
collection.eligibility: Existing measurement rules plus common-score/threshold/availability audits
collection.independent_unit: Whole record; event observations and overlapping windows are not independent replicates

stages: Implement isolated code and technical checks; no new collection
Development only on the already inspected v0.5 record; no candidate search or proof claim
Fix sources, runtime, schedule, evaluation and authorization in a new threshold-guard-freeze-v1 package
Only after separate authorization collect the nine new records in the predeclared order
For each technically valid record save all eight outputs and their barrier before outcome evaluation
Do not read intermediate quality; evaluate only after all nine measurement gates and output barriers pass
implementation_scope: New isolated scenario schedule, eight-output barrier and evaluator supporting normal-only C. Do not use legacy four-output/two-event process unchanged or modify its frozen results.

metrics.primary: New notification before the actual short event ends, first in A; unchanged 10s observed recovery
secondary: Point anomaly flags and delay as diagnostics
Threshold trajectories and composite processing costs
metrics.ordinary_duration: Left-held alarm integrated only over predeclared ordinary intervals, excluding actual event envelopes and unclassified transitions; no gaps over 3s or tail extrapolation
metrics.availability: Same saved-input arrival times plus relevant shared and own measured computation; not browser delivery

primary_limited_vs_fixed.additional_required_benefit: At least one extra timely detected event OR at least one fewer ordinary notification in total OR at least 10s less ordinary alarm duration in total

screening_success.secondary: Describe expected-cycles results separately; they cannot rescue a failed primary comparison
screening_success.precision_note: Do not round before comparison. Only <=1e-6 seconds of arithmetic discrepancy in ordinary-duration integration is ignored; this is not an accepted degradation margin.
screening_success.statistical_scope: Predeclared engineering go/no-go screening; no power or significance claim from nine records

stop_rules: No automatic repeats, replacements, resuming or dropping unsuccessful records
A failed measurement/output gate makes the nine-record series incomplete; quality remains closed pending a separately approved amendment
Any source/runtime/rule change invalidates the new future freeze; preserve old data
No progress for 10s, schedule action >1s late or collection >1780s: existing technical stop
No gain, benefit only over updated but not fixed, or more ordinary alarms: do not claim success
Do not vary the 0.10 step, windows, injected workload or 10s notification rule after viewing results

budget.excludes: Implementation, technical repairs and author review; not a promise of a positive result
